Now I will view a reference image for Anthracnose to compare.

thought
The reference image for Anthracnose shows a young, light brown mango leaf with irregular holes and damage. This does not match the test image, which has powdery white spots on a darker, mature leaf. This makes Anthracnose a less likely candidate.

Next, I will view a reference image for Sooty Mould.

thought
The reference image for Sooty Mould shows a leaf with dark, patchy, almost black superficial growth. While the test image has some darker areas, the primary feature is the whitish, powdery appearance, which is distinct from the predominantly black, sooty growth seen here. Therefore, Sooty Mould is also less likely.

Finally, I will view a reference image for Die_Back.

The reference image for Die_Back shows a completely dried, brown, and curled leaf, which is a very different symptom from the test image's whitish, powdery spots on a still-greenish leaf. This rules out Die_Back.

Based on the comparison of the test image with the reference images and symptom descriptions, the test image most closely matches the symptoms of Powdery Mildew. The whitish, powdery spots are characteristic of Powdery Mildew, and the reference image for Powdery Mildew clearly depicts this. The other diseases (Anthracnose, Sooty Mould, Die_Back) have distinct symptoms that do not align with the test image.
